Favourite button for YouTube ReVanced videos with madeForKids=true
The Favourite button will be enabled but videos liked on YouTube might appear as not liked in the widget.

Videos that return madeForKids=true never correctly reflect the like state due to a YouTube API bug – videos liked on YouTube appear as not liked in the widget. The Favourite button will be disabled to prevent confusion.

reboot – started with the launcher after the device restarted
start – started with the launcher after it restarted on its own (crash, update)
wake – started when the device woke up
user – started by hand with “Logcat service”
full – holds all of the device's logs
pid – holds the launcher's logs only
